device: CPU preparation and evaluation; S3 seed42 CPU, remaining five seeds GPU
precision: float32; GPU AMP, TF32 and compilation disabled
inference: seed42 paired whole-learner bootstrap; 2000 requested; 97.5% basic per two main contrasts plus 95% diagnostics, fixed and reselected separately; do not discard nonfinite draws
stop: No separate factorial ablations of the state and closure losses, no architecture search, no additional record-shuffling condition, and no refitting of accounting, autoregressive, generating-control or mechanism models. Negative scientific outcomes do not trigger extra tuning.
future_mask_policy: Exclude all lineage columns from inputs AND future-target average; no direct macrostate gradient or checkpoint selection in S3.
cpu_bridge: Archived GPU/BF16 predictions remain immutable. CPU replay is a separate numeric view; checkpoint/input/target identities are checked; nontrivial precision shifts are reported, not relabeled as exact reproduction.

reporting_clarifications.primary_support: fixed; reselected is separately labelled support sensitivity
reporting_clarifications.intervals: nominal method ranges conditional on frozen models; finite draws and same-sign methods do not validate coverage
reporting_clarifications.adjustment_family: two prespecified contrasts within each block; not a joint guarantee across all blocks
reporting_clarifications.comparison_objects: actual same-readout T-S, conditional proposal P-S, and endpoint N-X remain distinct
reporting_clarifications.execution_status: technical smoke is distinct from formal scientific execution
reporting_clarifications.pure_ssl_role: existing evidence for recovery without direct macro encoder losses; retains derived inputs and separate probes

cpu_reference_alternative: The all command preserves the original three-seed CPU control design; use cpu plus slurm_s3.sbatch for the reported six-seed design.
